sup_tls.quote: Start IV hydration and allopurinol 300 mg daily 1-2 days before chemotherapy

sup_svc_airway.quote: written escalation plan for stridor, progressive facial or arm swelling, or orthopnea

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg non-reactive, anti-HBc non-reactive, anti-HBs reactive (vaccine-immune), so no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed
